corrected: The 2025 Bear Gulch Fire (~20,000+ acres) burned into the Staircase/Lake Cushman and North Fork Skokomish area. problem: South Shore Road reopened Oct 8, 2026, so North Shore is no longer the only way in.
corrected: From US-101 at Lake Quinault take North Shore Road about 14 miles to the North/South Shore intersection, then North Fork Quinault Road about 4 miles to the trailhead and ranger station. South Shore Road, washed out since 2024, reopened Oct 8, 2026 and leads to Graves Creek; the temporary bridge joining the two shore roads is removed for the winter. The Elwha approach via Whiskey Bend is a genuine alternative but is foot and bike only: Olympic Hot Springs Road has been shut to vehicles beyond Madison Falls since November 2017 flood damage, adding roughly 7 miles each way.
